name: CodeBuild buildspec — Java + Maven
description: CodeBuild buildspec (committed to cicd/buildspec.yml; run by the codepipeline module): Build + unit tests + JaCoCo coverage gate; container targets: Docker build + ECR push + imagedefinitions.json; EC2 targets: artifact upload to S3 + CodeDeploy revision; Lambda targets: function package upload + update-function-code + smoke invoke

name: CodeBuild buildspec — Java + Gradle
description: CodeBuild buildspec for Gradle builds (wrapper when present): build + unit tests + JaCoCo coverage gate (init script, build file untouched); container targets: Docker build + ECR push + imagedefinitions.json; EC2 targets: artifact upload to S3 + CodeDeploy revision; Lambda targets: function package upload + update-function-code + smoke invoke

name: CodeBuild buildspec — Node.js + npm
description: CodeBuild buildspec (committed to cicd/buildspec.yml; run by the codepipeline module): Build, lint, unit tests + c8 coverage gate; container targets: Docker build + ECR push + imagedefinitions.json; EC2 targets: artifact upload to S3 + CodeDeploy revision; Lambda targets: function package upload + update-function-code + smoke invoke

name: CodeBuild buildspec — Python + pip
description: CodeBuild buildspec (committed to cicd/buildspec.yml; run by the codepipeline module): Lint, unit tests + coverage.py gate; container targets: Docker build + ECR push + imagedefinitions.json; EC2 targets: artifact upload to S3 + CodeDeploy revision; Lambda targets: function package upload + update-function-code + smoke invoke

name: CD — Deploy to ECS (CodePipeline)
description: Pipeline (CodeCommit default branch → CodeBuild running cicd/buildspec.yml → ECS) + ECS Deploy stage are provisioned by the Terraform `codepipeline` module (CodeCommit → CodeBuild → ECS). Deploy stage consumes imagedefinitions.json from the build artifact — no additional YAML is required.

name: Dockerfile — Java (Corretto, non-root)
description: Emitted into the build module ONLY when it has no Dockerfile: Amazon Corretto (multi-arch) base, runs the jar the buildspec copies to build/app.jar as a non-root user, with a HEALTHCHECK on the app health path.

name: CD — Deploy to EC2 via CodeDeploy (CodePipeline)
description: Deploy stage is the Terraform `codepipeline` module's CodeDeploy action (deploy_target=ec2): in-place, one instance at a time behind the ALB, auto-rollback. The buildspec assembles the revision from cicd/codedeploy/.

name: CD — Deploy to Lambda (CodePipeline)
description: No Deploy stage (deploy_target=lambda): the buildspec uploads the function package, runs update-function-code --publish and smoke-invokes the health path.

name: CodeDeploy revision — appspec.yml
description: CodeDeploy AppSpec: copy app/ to install_dir, stop/start the systemd unit, validate the health path

name: CodeDeploy revision — application_stop.sh
description: ApplicationStop hook: stop the systemd unit (absent unit is not an error)

name: CodeDeploy revision — application_start.sh
description: ApplicationStart hook: restart the systemd unit (fails if the unit is missing)

name: CodeDeploy revision — validate_service.sh
description: ValidateService hook: health path must answer 200 on localhost
